# dagsterplus_alert_policy (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ alert policy from a deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing alert policy created outside Terraform
data "dagsterplus_alert_policy" "existing" {
  deployment  = "prod"
  name        = "asset-health-degraded"
  policy_type = "asset"
}

output "notification_type" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_alert_policy.existing.notification_service.type
}

output "event_types" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_alert_policy.existing.event_types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment` (String) The name of the deployment the alert policy belongs to.
- `name` (String) The name of the alert policy to look up.
- `policy_type` (String) The category of alert policy: asset, run, code_location, automation, budget, or insight_metric.

### Read-Only

- `asset` (Block List) Asset-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = asset). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--asset))
- `automation` (Block List) Automation-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = automation). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--automation))
- `budget` (Block List) Budget-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = budget). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--budget))
- `code_location` (Block List) Code location-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = code_location). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--code_location))
- `description` (String) A human-readable description of the alert policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert policy is active.
- `event_types` (List of String) Event types that trigger the alert.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier in the form `{deployment}/{name}`.
- `insight_metric` (Block List) Insight metric-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = insight_metric). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--insight_metric))
- `notification_service` (Block, Read-only) The notification channel configured for this alert policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notification_service))
- `run` (Block List) Run-specific configuration (populated when policy_type = run). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--run))

<a id="nestedblock--asset"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asset`

Read-Only:

- `all_assets` (Boolean) True when the policy applies to all assets.
- `asset_key` (String) Specific asset key path.
- `asset_selection` (String) Asset selection string (e.g. 'tag:my-tag').
- `health_status` (String) Health status transition: degraded, warning, or healthy.
- `specific_events` (List of String) Specific asset events that trigger the alert.


<a id="nestedblock--automation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `automation`

Read-Only:

- `all_schedules_and_sensors` (Boolean) True when the policy applies to all schedules and sensors.
- `code_locations` (List of String) Code location names filter.
- `include_schedules` (Boolean) Whether schedules are included.
- `include_sensors` (Boolean) Whether sensors are included.
- `min_consecutive_failures` (Number) Minimum consecutive failures before alerting.
- `schedules_and_sensors` (List of String) Specific schedule or sensor names.


<a id="nestedblock--budget"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budget`

Read-Only:

- `operator` (String) Comparison operator: greater_than or less_than.
- `period_days` (Number) Period in days over which to measure.
- `threshold` (Number) Budget threshold value.


<a id="nestedblock--code_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `code_location`

Read-Only:

- `all_locations` (Boolean) True when the policy applies to all code locations.
- `location_name` (String) Specific code location name.


<a id="nestedblock--insight_metric"></a>
### Nested Schema for `insight_metric`

Read-Only:

- `asset_group` (String) Asset group name filter.
- `asset_key` (String) Asset key filter (slash-delimited path).
- `job_name` (String) Job name filter.
- `metric` (String) The metric being monitored.

- `threshold` (Number) Metric threshold value.


<a id="nestedblock--notification_service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_service`

Read-Only:

- `body_template` (String) Templated request body sent with each generic webhook request.
- `default_email_addresses` (List of String) Fallback email addresses for email_owners notifications.
- `email_addresses` (List of String) Email addresses to notify.
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Arbitrary HTTP headers sent with each generic webhook request.

<a id="nestedblock--run"></a>
### Nested Schema for `run`

Read-Only:

- `code_locations` (List of String) Code location names filter.

- `on_failure` (Boolean) Alert on run failure.
